boards.name: Office for National Statistics
boards.notes: Government statistics office; its careers site (careers.ons.gov.uk) lists its own vacancies. No employer pricing, API, partner or parent company stated on the pages read.

sources.title: About us
sources.quote: We are the UK’s largest independent producer of official statistics

boards.name: Expats.cz Jobs
boards.notes: Job posts are bought as credits: Basic job 1 credit, Premium job 2 credits, 1 credit listed at 3,000 CZK + DPH. Footer names Howlings s.r.o. as copyright holder; no parent company stated. No API, partner program or ingest method stated on the pages read.

sources.title: Expats.cz Job Credits
sources.quote: Premium jobs require 2 credits, while Basic jobs require 1.

boards.name: CVMarket.lv
boards.notes: Latvian job board. Single job ad priced from 160 EUR (2 weeks) or 180 EUR (1 month) plus VAT. Contact page gives a Riga address. Language switcher options other than LV were not captured in the browser reader. Parent company and API not stated on the pages read; the about page returned HTTP 502 and was not retried.

boards.name: Phenom
boards.notes: HR technology vendor (talent intelligence platform), not a standalone job board. Footer links to a partner marketplace with partner tiers. Headquarters, language options, API and parent company not stated on the pages read.

sources.title: Homepage footer
sources.quote: © 2026 Phenom People, Inc. All Rights Reserved.

boards.name: Heidrick & Struggles
boards.notes: Executive search firm; its careers page links to its own open positions on a Workday site. Only English appears in the language switcher. No pricing, API, partner program or parent company stated.

sources.title: About us footer
sources.quote: Heidrick & Struggles International, Inc. • 233 South Wacker Drive Willis Tower • Suite 4900 • Chicago, IL 60606-6303

boards.name: IMPACT Group
boards.notes: Coaching, relocation and outplacement firm, not a job board. Contact page lists a Saint Louis, MO office. Language switcher, parent company, employer pricing and API not stated on the pages read.

boards.name: Concorsando
boards.notes: Italian public-competition preparation site with a listing blog. The homepage and its visible links state no headquarters, language options, employer pricing, API or partner program. No about or legal page was linked from the homepage.
